# WebForTrades

> WebForTrades is a UK web design service that builds websites and free preview
> (demo) sites exclusively for tradespeople. You see a finished demo of your own
> website live on your phone before you pay anything, and only pay if you want to
> keep it. Founded by Julius Prodan.

## What We Do

We build your website as a free demo first. You see it live before paying, and you
only pay if you love it. No upfront payment and no risk. Pricing is a one-off payment
or an optional monthly plan, with no contracts, no retainers and no lock-in.

## Who It Is For

UK tradespeople who rely on Google, WhatsApp and local enquiries and want a simple,
fast website without the hassle or the agency price tag. It suits sole traders and
small trade businesses that may have no website, an out-of-date one, or only a
Facebook page.

## Trades We Cover

Roofers, plasterers, plumbers, electricians, painters and decorators, landscapers,
gardeners, tilers, builders, bricklayers, joiners, carpenters, gas engineers,
handymen and similar UK trades.

## What Is Included

- A finished website built for your trade, with a quote and contact form
- Mobile optimised and fast on phones, where most trade customers search
- Free hosting, with no annual renewal fee
- A .co.uk domain set up for you
- Ongoing changes and edits when you need them
- An optional self-service editor so you can update content yourself
- Help connecting your site to your Google Business Profile
- Basic local SEO so the site can be found on Google

## Pricing

One-off plans (pay once, you own it):
- Starter, £300: single-page site with quote form, .co.uk domain, free hosting, mobile optimised, basic local SEO.
- Professional, £500: 5-page site (Home, About, Services, Portfolio, Quote), full on-page SEO, Google Maps and reviews integration, ongoing support.
- Premium, £800: everything in Professional plus individual service pages, local area pages, advanced SEO, priority support.

Monthly plans (optional, if you prefer to spread the cost):
- From £39, £59 or £89 per month depending on the plan.

## How The Free Demo Works

1. You fill in a short form with your trade, area and a few details.
2. We build a demo of your website, usually within 48 hours.
3. You view it live on your phone. No payment, no deposit, no obligation.
4. If you like it, you pay once and we put it live. If not, you walk away and owe nothing.

## What Makes It Different

- You see a finished website before paying, not a mock-up or a sales pitch.
- Built only for tradespeople, so the layout fits how trade customers actually search and call.
- One-off pricing with free hosting and no annual renewal, as well as an optional monthly plan.
- No contracts, no retainers, no lock-in.

## Common Questions

**Do I pay anything upfront?** No. We build the demo first, you see it live, and you only pay if you want to keep it. No deposits.

**How long does the demo take?** Usually within 48 hours of filling in the form.

**Is hosting included?** Yes, with no annual renewal fee on the one-off plans.

**Can I request changes?** Yes, changes and edits are included.

**Can I update the website myself?** Yes, an optional self-service editor is available so you can edit content yourself.

**Am I tied to a contract?** No contracts, no retainers and no lock-in.

**Can I pay monthly?** Yes. There is a one-off option and an optional monthly plan.
